code.r:
pts = polling_places %>%
  filter(id %in% c(1, 120)) %>%
  st_transform(crs = 26986)

st_crs(pts)$units_gdal
d = st_distance(pts)[1, 2]

zone = pts %>%
  st_buffer(dist = 1000)   # 1 km in the CRS unit (metres)

a = precincts %>%
  filter(ward_precinct == "0101") %>%
  st_transform(crs = 26986) %>%
  st_area()
code.sql:
SELECT ST_Distance(ST_Transform(a.geom, 26986),
                   ST_Transform(b.geom, 26986)) AS d_crs,
       ST_Distance(a.geom::geography, b.geom::geography) AS d_geography
FROM polling_places a, polling_places b
WHERE a.id = 1 AND b.id = 120;

code.r:
sf_use_s2(FALSE)   # treat lon/lat as flat x/y

pts = polling_places %>%
  filter(id %in% c(1, 120)) %>%
  st_transform(crs = 4326)

st_crs(pts)$units_gdal
d = st_distance(pts)[1, 2]

zone = pts %>%
  st_buffer(dist = 0.01)   # planar: 0.01 of a DEGREE

a = precincts %>%
  filter(ward_precinct == "0101") %>%
  st_transform(crs = 4326) %>%
  st_area()
code.sql:
SELECT ST_Distance(ST_Transform(a.geom, 4326),
                   ST_Transform(b.geom, 4326)) AS d_crs,
       ST_Distance(a.geom::geography, b.geom::geography) AS d_geography
FROM polling_places a, polling_places b
WHERE a.id = 1 AND b.id = 120;
